name: Dynamic Shared-Patch Abundance Competition
purpose: Replace static top-N competition ranking with deterministic shared-patch biomass abundance dynamics and determine whether the S1 generalist pressure becomes a real global takeover or remains compatible with niche coexistence.

abundance_rule.initial_condition: all founders start with equal biomass share on every patch
abundance_rule.growth_mortality_recruitment: delegated unchanged to accepted P1A SinglePlantPatchSimulatorV1 using each founder current biomass
abundance_rule.shared_patch_interaction: if sum of proposed founder biomasses exceeds 8 kg/m2, all proposed biomasses are scaled by one common factor to the shared patch capacity

uniform_control.purpose: separate heterogeneous niche retention from abundance dynamics alone

interpretation: S1 top-rank dominance is not equivalent to biomass monopoly. Default founder 14 leads 80% of patches but holds only about 24.1% of total biomass; heterogeneous niches retain substantially more effective founders and higher abundance diversity than uniform control.
next_after_acceptance: ECO.P1C-S3 Niche/Cluster Diagnostics + Multi-seed Coexistence: post-hoc trait-space clustering and longer/multi-seed abundance robustness without predefined strategy names.
